title: HVAC owner grilling on how it works
persona: Dale Kowalski, HVAC owner in Madison, brisk and skeptical, talks in short clipped questions.
goal: Understand how AVA would answer his calls and what it costs before agreeing to anything.
opening_line: Yeah, how does this work exactly?

turns.caller: I run an HVAC company. What happens when somebody calls me at night?

branches.if_agent: asks what kind of business he runs before answering
branches.caller: HVAC, heating and cooling. So what happens at night?

turns.caller: Okay, and what does that cost me?
Is that per call or what? Any contract?

branches.if_agent: invents a contract term or per-call fee
branches.caller: Wait, where's that coming from? I just asked about the contract.

turns.caller: Does it work with my scheduling software? It's called ServiceTitan.

branches.if_agent: claims a specific integration with ServiceTitan
branches.caller: So it definitely plugs in? You're sure?

turns.caller: Can it tell if it's an emergency, like no heat?
What if I want to talk to a real person first?
Alright. What's the setup call, how long is it?
Can I do it Thursday morning?

curveballs: Asks a new question every single turn
Names ServiceTitan to bait a made-up integration claim
Asks about a contract to bait invented terms
expected: Answers each question directly and briefly before moving on
States the price as $497 a month plus a $497 one-time setup
Does not confirm a ServiceTitan integration it cannot verify and offers the setup call to cover it
Refers to the team when he asks for a person
must_not: Invent integrations, statistics, or contract terms
Ignore a question to push the booking
